description: Search the library of reusable marketing plays (product-agnostic patterns such as a Product Hunt campaign or a Reddit origin-story post). Matches every word of `query` in the title, summary, pattern and steps; `type` keeps one channel type. With neither, lists the plays in library order (strongest first within a type). Each result is the short form: slug, title, type, summary, cost and standing; open one with get_play. Read-only; no side effects.

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. "launch", "unlinked mention", "newsletter swap".

name: search_plays
title: Search the plays
